Across the Gaza Strip, Israeli bullets have pierced makeshift classrooms, wounded students at their desks and killed children during lessons. Al-Quds School in Khan Younis has resorted to earthen barriers to protect its students from Israeli gunfire. Israeli attacks killed 14 children and school students in October 2026 alone, according to Palestinian education authorities. Some were shot inside makeshift classrooms, while others were killed on their way to or from school. More than 20,500 school and university students have been killed in Gaza since October 2023, the ministry revealed.

🇳🇵 Kathmandu: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah leaves for Delhi from Kathmandu Airport. He will arrive for a two-day State visit from November 22 to 23 at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The visit marks Shah's first visit to India since taking office in March 2026, as well as his first bilateral visit abroad in his capacity as Prime Minister. After fuelling anti-India sentiment, blocking Indian vehicles and stopping goods worth over ₹100 at the border, Balen Shah is now seeking $2 billion in financial aid from the same India.
